text.tspan: S3 for compliance: secure the path, the bytes, the access, and prove it
Bucket policy: Deny if aws:SecureTransport = false
SSE-KMS with a customer managed key + Bucket Key
(SSE-S3 is only the default since Jan 2023)
Key rotation, deletion window 30 days, tight key policy
DSSE-KMS / client-side if rules demand it
Changing default encryption doesn't re-encrypt old objects: copy in place or S3 Batch Operations.
Force YOUR key with a Deny on s3:PutObject when s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption-aws-kms-key-id isn't your key ARN.
Bucket Key = far fewer KMS requests, much lower cost.
